leagues.name: NFL
leagues.verdict: No edge: Kalshi priced games almost exactly like the sportsbooks (3+ points cheaper only 3 times in 718 prices).
points: Kalshi's pre-game prices were less accurate than the sportsbooks' closing lines (718 prices compared), so Kalshi sometimes lags the books.

Big favorites (70¢ and up): 163 bets, 76% won, -3.0% per bet.
